author: Totally Not Mark
description:
With episode 1 of Dragon Ball Super Beerus right around the corner, I've been feeling a bit nostalgic. Which got me thinking, Dragon Ball Super's got a lot of detractors and a pretty conflicted reputation online. What were the episodes and creative choices that caused that feeling in the first place? 

Today we're diving into Goku's journey from Super Saiyan God, Blue and Ultra Instinct to answer that very question!

title: The Episodes That Ruined Dragon Ball Super's Reputation
